newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian police kill four militants in raid.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian police kill four militants in raid.

text.p: Egyptian police killed four suspected Islamist militants in a dawn raid near the southern town of Samalout on Tuesday, security sources said.
They said the bodies of the four militants were found along with automatic rifles in a field in the village of el-Beho after a shootout with police there.

Police went to the fields early on Tuesday morning after a tip that militants were using the area to hide, the sources said. The shootout lasted for several hours. There were no police casualties, the sources said.
No further details were immediately available but Interior Minister Hassan el-Alfi confirmed the incident while he was inaugurating a new police building in Cairo.

Samalout, in the Nile valley 200 km (125 miles) south of Cairo, is in Minya province, the centre of the long conflict between the police and the militant Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), which says it is fighting to overthrow the government.
More than 1,000 people have been killed in the conflict since the Gama'a took up arms in 1992.
